label: Beneficial Ownership Orchestration
description: Identify and verify beneficial owners across two regimes at once: AMLR (EU) 2024/1624 UBO obligations (25% ownership-or-control threshold, indirect/multi-tier chains, senior-managing-official fallback, nominees, trusts and legal arrangements, BO-register cross-checking post-CJEU C-37/20) and the EU FDI Screening Regulation (EU) 2019/452 controlling-ownership lens for sensitive sectors. Produces a dual-threshold cross-walk that shows who is a UBO for AML/CFT versus who is a controlling owner triggering FDI screening, and where the ownership-chain analysis is shared versus divergent.

claudeKnowledge.description: AMLR (EU) 2024/1624 (UBO / beneficial ownership, applicable 10 July 2027); the EU FDI Screening Regulation (EU) 2019/452 (in force since 11 October 2020); CJEU Case C-37/20 (WM and Sovim, 22 November 2022) on BO-register public access; AMLD-era central BO registers; FATF Recommendations 24 and 25 (beneficial ownership of legal persons and arrangements).

guidedInputs.label: Structure Type
guidedInputs.description: What kind of legal person or arrangement sits at the top of the chain you are analysing?

options.label: Listed company or subsidiary of a listed group
Investment fund / holding SPV / GP-LP structure
Trust or similar legal arrangement (foundation, fideicomiso, Anstalt)

guidedInputs.label: Jurisdiction(s) of the Chain
guidedInputs.description: Where are the entities in the ownership chain incorporated or administered? Select all that apply.

options.label: Offshore / third country in the chain

guidedInputs.label: Regimes in Scope
guidedInputs.description: Which ownership lenses should the orchestration apply? Run both to produce the dual-threshold cross-walk.

options.label: Dual-threshold cross-walk (shared vs divergent chain analysis)

guidedInputs.label: FDI-Sensitive Sector Exposure
guidedInputs.description: Does the target operate in a sector caught by Art. 4 of Reg. (EU) 2019/452 (critical infrastructure, critical tech, dual-use, critical inputs, sensitive data, media)? Drives whether the FDI lens is live.

options.label: Critical infrastructure (energy, transport, water, health, financial market infra)
Critical / dual-use technology (AI, semiconductors, quantum, cyber, aerospace)
Critical inputs (energy supply, raw materials, food security)
Sensitive personal data or media / press
Multiple or unsure — assess sector exposure

guidedInputs.label: Known Structure Facts & Concerns
guidedInputs.description: Paste the ownership chain as known, plus any concerns: layering, nominees, bearer instruments, no natural person above threshold, register discrepancies, foreign-government or sovereign-fund involvement, opacity of an intermediate vehicle.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g. Three-tier chain: EU OpCo held 60% by a Lux HoldCo, which is held 40% by a Cayman fund and 60% by a family trust; no single natural person appears to exceed 25% by direct count; one intermediate vehicle has nominee shareholders; a sovereign wealth fund holds a 12% blocking-rights stake at OpCo level.

exampleInput: We are running enhanced due diligence on a proposed acquisition target, NordGrid Systems AB (a Swedish operator of SCADA software for regional power distribution), ahead of onboarding the acquirer as a corporate banking client and assessing whether the deal trips FDI screening. The chain as disclosed: NordGrid AB is 100% owned by NordGrid Holding S.à r.l. (Luxembourg). NordGrid Holding is owned 45% by Aurelia Capital Fund II SCSp (a Lux GP-LP fund, GP is Aurelia Capital Management S.à r.l.), 30% by Meridian Family Trust (a Jersey discretionary trust, settlor deceased, protector is a Swiss lawyer), and 25% by Cobalt Strategic Investments Ltd (BVI, which we understand is a co-invest vehicle for a Gulf sovereign-linked LP). No natural person appears to hold 25% directly. Please orchestrate the beneficial-ownership analysis under AMLR — identify the UBOs through the layered chain, apply the senior-managing-official fallback if needed, deal with the trust roles and the nominee question — AND in parallel run the FDI Screening Regulation lens, because NordGrid sits in critical energy infrastructure and there is apparent foreign/sovereign control. Give me the dual-threshold cross-walk showing who is a UBO versus who is a controlling owner for FDI, where the chain analysis is shared, and flag the BO-register reconciliation we need to file.

exampleValues.known_concerns: Three-tier chain via a Lux HoldCo. Holders: 45% Lux GP-LP fund (Aurelia Capital Fund II SCSp), 30% Jersey discretionary trust (settlor deceased, Swiss-lawyer protector), 25% BVI co-invest vehicle understood to front a Gulf sovereign-linked LP. No natural person at or above 25% by direct count. Nominee shareholders suspected at the BVI layer. Target is critical energy infrastructure (SCADA for power distribution), so apparent foreign/sovereign control likely trips FDI screening. BO-register extract for the Lux HoldCo lists only the GP director as UBO — suspected discrepancy to be reported.
